slice: PL Physics Simulation and Computational Research

capabilities.name: PL Physics API
capabilities.description: Provide a PL-owned physics contract over a proven production backend while preserving backend replacement and multi-backend support.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Required outcomes and Wave 1.8.1 Production rigid-body physics core
capabilities.notes: Existing physics foundations count as partial; Official-v1 requires a production contract and conformance suite.

capabilities.name: Production Rigid-Body Core
capabilities.description: Provide worlds, fixed timesteps, body modes, colliders, materials, forces, impulses, gravity, damping, sleeping, triggers, and collision layers.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.1 Production rigid-body physics core

capabilities.name: Physics Queries Constraints and Controllers
capabilities.description: Provide raycasts, sweeps, overlaps, contacts, joints, constraints, character controllers, and collision events.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.1 Production rigid-body physics core

capabilities.name: Physics Diagnostics Replay and Tracing
capabilities.description: Provide broad and narrow phase diagnostics, contact visualization, force and velocity overlays, step controls, snapshots, replay, and event tracing.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.1 Production rigid-body physics core

capabilities.name: Rigid-Body Conformance Suite
capabilities.description: Validate stacks, ramps, friction, restitution, joints, tunneling, high-speed bodies, scale extremes, determinism limits, and save/reload stability.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.1 Production rigid-body physics core

capabilities.name: Physics Execution and Trust Modes
capabilities.description: Provide explicit real-time, deterministic, engineering-approximation, scientific-experiment, and experimental execution modes.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.2 Physics modes precision and backend replacement
capabilities.notes: Each mode must expose its guarantees, limitations, precision, warnings, and validation status.

capabilities.name: Physics Backend Replacement
capabilities.description: Provide backend adapters and compatibility tests so production third-party and experimental PL-native implementations can coexist behind one API.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.2 Physics modes precision and backend replacement
capabilities.notes: Experimental solvers must never silently replace production behavior.

capabilities.name: Units and Quantities System
capabilities.description: Provide unit and quantity algebra, conversions, dimensional validation, constants, vectors, matrices, parameters, and uncertainty metadata.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.3 Units quantities expressions and equations
capabilities.notes: Units must integrate with spreadsheets, model dimensions, physics properties, plots, probes, workflows, imports, and exports.

capabilities.name: Expressions Equations and Computational Graphs
capabilities.description: Provide expression parsing, functions, constraints, equation systems, safe computational graphs, and prevention of invalid mathematical operations.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.3 Units quantities expressions and equations

capabilities.name: Numerical Computation Foundation
capabilities.description: Provide linear algebra, root finding, interpolation, quadrature, numerical differentiation, ODE integration, optimization basics, statistics, distributions, and transforms.
capabilities.notes: Configurable tolerance and precision should be exposed where practical.

capabilities.name: Numerical Error and Convergence Reporting
capabilities.description: Report convergence, stability, conservation, error estimates, iterations, tolerances, and solver failure reasons.
capabilities.notes: Approved cases should be cross-checked against analytical solutions and trusted implementations.

capabilities.name: Reproducible Experiment System
capabilities.description: Store assumptions, inputs, units, environment versions, solver settings, outputs, notes, citations, warnings, and validation results for repeatable experiments.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.5 Experiments sweeps uncertainty and batch research

capabilities.name: Sweeps Batch Research and Uncertainty
capabilities.description: Provide parameter sweeps, batch experiments, Monte Carlo foundations, sensitivity studies, solver comparisons, checkpoints, caching, cancellation, and reproducible random seeds.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.5 Experiments sweeps uncertainty and batch research
capabilities.notes: Experiment execution should integrate with workflows, queues, Command Center, CLI, Docs, and Spreadsheets.

capabilities.name: Scientific Visualization
capabilities.description: Provide scalar, vector, field, geometry, time-series, phase, distribution, heatmap, comparison, playback, probe, and 2D/3D plotting tools.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.6 Scientific visualization and computational notebooks
capabilities.notes: Plots must preserve units, solver metadata, and provenance.

capabilities.name: Computational Notebook and Experiment Workspace
capabilities.description: Provide a workspace combining equations, narrative, plots, tables, simulations, parameters, and results into a reproducible research record.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.6 Scientific visualization and computational notebooks
capabilities.notes: Complete result packages must export to Docs, Spreadsheets, images, tables, and project assets.

capabilities.name: Scientific Research Module Extension Points
capabilities.description: Provide extension points for orbital mechanics, electromagnetism, particles, structural approximations, thermal systems, fluids, controls, robotics, and hardware data.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.7 Research modules and PL-native solver program
capabilities.notes: Specialized scientific domains should extend the shared computation model instead of bloating the base runtime.

capabilities.name: Experimental PL-Native Solver Module
capabilities.description: Run at least one experimental PL-native physics or simulation module behind the common physics API without requiring slice-specific changes.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.7 Research modules and PL-native solver program
capabilities.notes: The module remains explicitly experimental until evidence supports stronger claims.

capabilities.name: Scientific Validation Library
capabilities.description: Maintain analytical solutions, textbook cases, published benchmarks, and trusted cross-tool comparisons for scientific validation.
capabilities.source: v1.8 — Wave 1.8.7 Research modules and PL-native solver program
capabilities.notes: Experimental results may not be labeled scientifically validated without recorded evidence and known limitations.
